environmentIncident.found: The target branch `worktree-of1-data` had never been pushed to the `aem-growth-adoption/arco` GitHub remote, so AEM Code Sync had never synced its code layer. The preview URL returned HTTP 200 with real DA content but served bare HTML with no `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles/styles.css">` and no `<script src="/scripts/scripts.js">` — confirmed via curl diff against `main--arco--aem-growth-adoption.aem.page`, which has both. An initial capture attempt against the unsynced preview read back browser-default styles (Times New Roman, black text, rgb(0,0,238) links) instead of Arco's real Inter/cream/copper tokens.
environmentIncident.fix: Pushed the branch to the correct remote: `git push aem-growth HEAD:refs/heads/worktree-of1-data` (this worktree's `origin` remote is a personal fork, `froesef/arco`, not the org repo — `aem-growth` is the remote that maps to `aem-growth-adoption/arco` used by the aem.page preview URL). Code sync completed within ~10s; re-verified computed styles matched styles.css exactly before re-running the capture.
environmentIncident.impact: All three pages in this extraction were captured AFTER the fix, against the correctly-styled site. No degraded/placeholder data is present in the committed artifacts.
